name: facebookresearch_neuralcompression/projects/torch_vct/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.load_model_checkpoint_from_config: load a VCTPipeline model checkpoint from a config file and checkpoint path onto a specified device
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.load_model_with_state_dict: load a PyTorch model state dict from a checkpoint file and apply it to an instantiated model
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.instantiate_model_from_yaml_config: instantiate a model using hydra.utils from a YAML config file containing model architecture settings
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.save_checkpoint_copy: save a timestamped copy of the loaded model checkpoint state dict to the checkpoint directory
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.strip_model_prefix_from_state_dict: strip the model. prefix from state dict keys when loading checkpoints saved with a model wrapper

facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.show_image_tensor: display a PyTorch tensor image with custom mean and std normalization using matplotlib
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.show_video_clip: display a video clip tensor as a grid of frames using matplotlib subplots
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.show_image_custom_normalization: show an image tensor with custom mean and std values for denormalization before display
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.show_video_multirow: display a video clip tensor across multiple rows using the nrow parameter
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.review_show_image: review the show_image function that clips and normalizes a tensor for matplotlib display

facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.create_cache: create a memoize cache using create_cache for storing PyTorch computation results
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.memoize_decorator: apply the memoize decorator to a function to enable result caching on repeated calls
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.bind_function_to_cache: bind a memoized function to a cache instance using bind to enable caching
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.inspect_cache_hits: inspect cache hit counts for a memoized function using get_total_cache_hits
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.ensure_hashable: convert lists dicts and tensors into hashable tuples for use as cache keys

facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.create_linear_ramp_cosine_scheduler: create a LinearRampCosineLR scheduler with linear warmup followed by cosine annealing for a PyTorch optimizer
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.create_linear_ramp_linear_scheduler: create a LinearRampLinearLR scheduler with linear warmup followed by constant learning rate for a PyTorch optimizer
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.create_linear_warmup_cosine_scheduler: create a LinearWarmUpCosineLR scheduler with constant warmup followed by cosine annealing for a PyTorch optimizer
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.review_lr_scheduler_get_lr: review the get_lr method of LinearRampCosineLR to understand how it computes closed-form learning rates
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.refactor_lr_scheduler_ramp_len: refactor the ramp_len parameter in LinearRampLinearLR to support dynamic warmup length during training
